name: Roar of the Bear

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Alloy Casing
perks.desc:
Reduces weight for faster reloads.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Black Powder
perks.desc:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Impact Casing
perks.desc:
Increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.desc: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.desc: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.desc: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.desc: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.desc: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.desc: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. High-Impact(15) Solar Rocket Launcher Heavy Ammo. "Rocket Launchers have been around for so long it’s hard for any of them to break out. Damage is best reserved for Adept weapons or specific perks. Roar of the Bear does not get either of those. Vorpal is low stakes decent damage. Lasting Impression is great for killing yourself (ask me how I know) and Chain Reaction is best used when trying to clear adds. None of these are uncommon on other rockets within the last few seasons."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Blast Radius. High-Impact(15) Solar Rocket Launcher Heavy Ammo. "A similar story in PvP. Chain Reaction will net you multikills occasionally and Cluster Bomb can splash damage either securing the kill or just netting you some additional damage."

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): Recommended MW: Blast Radius. High-Impact(15) Solar Rocket Launcher Heavy Ammo. "A similar story in PvP. Chain Reaction will net you multikills occasionally and Cluster Bomb can splash damage either securing the kill or just netting you some additional damage."

[YeezyGT's S18] [MW: Handling] "Roar of the Bear does something many other Rockets can't. Combining Auto-Loading Holster with Demolitionist gives it great utility, and making it a dual-purpose Rocket for swapping with weapons like Izanagi's Burden. Impulse Amplifier / Auto-Loading Holster with high Handling makes this a top contender for Divinity users too, as you can maintain the Divinity cage while shooting off Rockets of your own." tags:pve

pandapaxxy (PvE Controller \ M+KB): Recommended MW: Reload “I wish legendary rocket launchers had more identities over just damage or single use boom sticks. Roar of the Bear is no exception to this rule. You can either set it up for maximum damage via field prep or demolitionist, paired with lasting impression, or vorpal weapon. OR set it up with chain reaction or incandescent and impulse amplifier so the boom gets there quicker. There really is not anything interesting or new with rockets, so keep on going for the usual.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Solar Rocket Launcher Heavy Ammo)

pandapaxxy (PvP Controller): Recommended MW: Blast Radius “Same thing in PvP. Legendary rockets have a lot to compete for when Wardcliff Coil, Gjallerhorn, Deathbringer, or even Two-Tailed Fox exist. If you are not using an exotic weapon, want to use a rocket, and are not using one of those above, you are crazy. Legendary rockets have so much they need to do in order to even be thought of because they are one and done. If you cannot secure that single kill, why not use an exotic rocket and know you will get that kill.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Solar Rocket Launcher Heavy Ammo)
